 Carrièreniveau: Ervaren (> 2 jaar) First, Arkipel 
Arkipel builds products that get people moving outside. Relive turns your ride, run or hike into a video you actually want to share. JOIN is a training coach for cyclists. REN does the same for runners. Kunu helps golfers understand their swing and fix it faster. Together they reach millions of people around the world who ride, run, hike and play. 
We are a team of ~35 people across 18 nationalities. Small teams, big products, no layers of management between an idea and the people it reaches. We build things we are genuinely proud of, and we move fast because we can. 
We believe the product is only half of what makes a brand win. Anyone can attempt to copy a training algorithm. Almost no one can copy the storytelling, the content and the community around it. It is what sets our brands apart, and we are doubling down on it. 
That is where you come in. Arkipel Studio: in at the very start 
The best content gets made from inside a brand: by people who use the products, know the sports and can jump on a moment the day it happens. So we are building Arkipel Studio : a small, sharp media team at the heart of the company, creating content and running campaigns for all Arkipel brands. 
You will be one of its first hires. That means real influence on how the studio works, what it makes and what it feels like. You will not inherit a playbook; you will help write it. 
The studio starts with three people. We are hiring two content creators , so you will have a creative partner from day one, and a performance marketer (paid social, Google, Apple Search Ads) in parallel.
